package.name: Huntington Bank Arena host media kit
package.status: Copy final, 15-page Chamber flip-book format built; cover exterior + airport photography in place, arena interior photography missing
package.format: Chamber flip book — 11 x 6.5 in landscape, spiral / wire-o bound

recipient.venue: Huntington Bank Arena and Conference Center

palette.rule: red only on cream spreads, gold only on navy spreads
palette.hba_green_use: the Arena's own green: the sample spot, and the cover co-brand rule

pages.title: Cover
pages.layout: Full-bleed hero. Logo top-left, venue eyebrow top-right, headline lower-left, PREPARED FOR card bottom-right. With exterior.jpg (and no cover.jpg) the photo runs as a top-right corner fade and the venue eyebrow moves under the logo.

pages.title: What we're proposing
pages.layout: Two-column: left copy + sample-spot screen render; right three numbered items. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Proof — Tupelo Regional
pages.layout: Two-column: left copy; right waiting-room photo card over a compact pull-quote card. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Already live, across town
pages.layout: Four real photo cards of the airport install (rotunda hero, live advertiser spot, ticket counter, gate area). Renders only when photos/airport.jpg exists. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: The network & the value
pages.layout: Stat row (static, top), local CPM bar comparison, and a photo card of a live local ad in a storefront.

pages.title: The company you'd keep
pages.layout: Three market chips, a two-column list of 28 Tupelo/Lee Co. venues, and a tall photo card of the loop running in a host venue.

pages.title: Where your screens would go
pages.layout: Six proposed zones, two columns of three. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Not a wall of ads
pages.layout: Four screens in a row showing the real loop — weather, news, trivia, and her event spot. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: What it costs you: nothing
pages.layout: Four $0 package cards across, then a bordered summary band.

pages.title: Sixty / forty
pages.layout: Two-column: left copy; right economics table + disclaimer. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Your calendar, on every screen we own
pages.layout: Two-column: left copy; right the lobby event board rendered inside a screen bezel. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Who we are
pages.layout: Big display headline left, body right, then a three-photo band of real host-venue installs. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Owner-operated, and local
pages.layout: Three large circular headshots with name, role and contact. Anchored stat row.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.layout: Two-column: left CTA + requirements card; right three contacts with headshots.
